'''Gargath's Watch''' was a region of the [[Clabburn Tundra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] that lay just north of [[Highmount Ridge]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the area was home to a massive [[Kintan crusher]] named [[Gargath]].
